log.msg: CSS prefix: ai- is the reserved scope for ext/AITask (css-scopes.txt), so every new class is ai-tree-*. Built by hand in the worktree, not create_page, because create_page writes the main tree.

minion A's tree.js landed (41a19ef2): phases are arrays of nodes, pct is 0-100, dir is '2026-09-29/x/y'. The views read that shape as-is; nested.js also accepts phases of dirs and falls back to layering by after.

decision.about: Which design shows nested tasks by default?

options.say: Phases as columns left to right, 'then' between them, tasks in a column run at once; subtasks nest as lanes inside a card
options.why: Parallel vs series is where a thing sits, not a word to read; nests to any depth; fills a 1920 or 3440 screen as a wall

options.say: An indented ui/item tree, each group badged 'together' or 'then', % at the end of each row
options.why: The most compact and scans fastest for a long day, but series is only a badge you have to read

options.say: A node graph: parent left, a column per phase, an arrow for every 'waits for'
options.why: Draws the dependencies best, but fixed-width boxes cut titles short and it shows only one level, subtasks as dots

decision.because: At 1280 and 1920, Lanes was the only one where you can tell parallel from series and see every level without reading a label.
